behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer receiving the stored word at +0x40024; esi = signed 32-bit input to clamp.

edges.above_clamp: esi = 13 gives eax = 12 (the first cmovle does not fire, the second does not fire).
edges.clamp_high_boundary: esi = 12 gives eax = 12 (the first cmovle fires with the input itself).
edges.default_boundary: esi = 0 gives eax = 9 (the second cmovle overrides the first).
edges.default_negative: esi = -1 gives eax = 9 (the second cmovle overrides the first).
edges.pass_through: esi = 1 gives eax = 1 (both cmovles fire in sequence, the second only for esi <= 0).
edges.top_of_range: esi = 0x7fffffff gives eax = 12; esi = -0x80000000 gives eax = 9.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; two cmovle instructions, no branches, no calls, one ret.
behavior.return_rule: No return value claimed: on exit eax holds the clamped value, but the packet claims only the word store at [rdi+0x40024]. The only write is that word store.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; three sites found, each confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
